---
title: "Curriculum Vitae"
format: awesomecv-typst
metadata-files:
  - _author-industry.yml
brand:
  typography:
    fonts:
      - family: Roboto
        source: google
        weight: [100, 400, 700]
      - family: Source Sans 3
        source: google
        weight: [100, 400, 700]
        style: [normal, italic]
    base: Source Sans 3
  color:
    primary: "#1A4E8A"
    link: "#7B3F5E"
  defaults:
    awesomecv-typst:
      font-header: Roboto
---

```{r}
source("../R/cv_helpers.R")
d <- cv_load()
v <- "industry"
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_emit("#set text(size: 10pt)", "typst")  # smaller body text to fit one page
cv_heading("Summary", "typst")
cv_print_text(d, v, c("intro_industry", "intro"))
cv_print_section(d, v, "education", "typst", "Education", compact = TRUE)
cv_print_section(d, v, "research_positions", "typst", "Research Experience", compact = TRUE)
cv_print_section(d, v, "industry_positions", "typst", "Professional Experience", compact = TRUE)
cv_print_skill_grid(d, v)
cv_print_section(d, v, c("reports", "academic_articles", "working_papers"), "typst",
                 "Selected Reports and Publications", compact = TRUE)
```
